git_directory.name: Git Directory
git_directory.description: Read Git commits and diffs from a local Git repository

author.description: The author name to filter commits (commit author contains this string)

git_directory.transformer: $data.split('\n').filter(line => line !== '').map(line => { const p = line.split('\t'); return p.length >= 4 ? { id: p[0], summary: p[1], createdAt: Number(p[3]) * 1000, data: { id: p[0], message: p[1], author: p[2], date: Number(p[3]) } } : null }).filter(Boolean)

clickup.name: ClickUp Tasks
clickup.description: Read ClickUp tasks updated on the current day and assigned to the specified user

user.description: The Assignee user ID to filter

clickup.transformer: $data.tasks.map(task => ({ id: `${task.id}-${task.date_updated}`, summary: task.name, createdAt: Number(task.date_updated), data: task }))

test_nodejs.name: Test Node.js
test_nodejs.transformer: ({ id: String(Date.now()), summary: 'Currency Date', createdAt: Date.now(), data: JSON.parse($data) })
